svg.title: Omitted Beijing sites: predictive medians, intervals and model criticism
svg.desc: Protected reference results for Dongsi and Guanyuan in calendar 2016. Top panels show observed eligible daily PM2.5 as dots, hierarchical-base posterior predictive mixture medians as lines and equal-tailed 90 percent marginal predictive intervals as shading. These are historical conditional predictions, not forecasts or simultaneous bands. Bottom left compares empirical MAE of the predictive median for every frozen model on the common eligible rows, separately by site. Bottom right shows hierarchical-base training residual lag-one autocorrelation and replicated 90 percent ranges; persistent residual dependence challenges the likelihood. Interval width is predictive uncertainty, not numerical MCSE. No physical mixture mean or variance is claimed.
